name: Tile Underlayment Explained: Ditra, Cement Board, and What Goes Where
title-tag: Tile Underlayment Explained: Ditra, Cement Board & More
meta-description: Tile underlayment in plain English: cement board, Ditra and uncoupling membranes, foam boards — what each one does, where each belongs, and what never works.
post-summary: September 29, 2026 · Underlayment — not tile — decides whether a tile floor cracks. A plain-English tour of the three families that matter: cement board, uncoupling membranes like Ditra, and waterproof foam boards, with an honest map of which one belongs over wood, concrete, and shower walls, and the substrates that should never see tile at all.
